title: The integrated sphere diffusion satisfies the weak forward equation
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The integrated sphere diffusion satisfies the weak forward equation. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let $X_t$ be a jointly measurable unit-sphere-valued process with almost surely continuous paths. Suppose its actual coordinates satisfy the specified integrated Brownian equation at every positive finite horizon with projected noise and its radial drift. For each twice continuously differentiable ambient test, the derivative of its expectation is the expected spherical generator. This is the ordinary derivative at positive times and the right derivative at time zero.
